wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Pomace Mountain |characters=ムスト山 |japanese=Must Mountain |image=Pomace Mountain.png |imagesize=285px |region=Kalos |epicode=XY034 |episode=The Bonds of Mega Evolution! }} '''Pomace Mountain''' (Japanese: '''ムスト山''' ''Must Mountain'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is located somewhere between [[Geosenge Town]] and [[Shalour City]]. The mountain was first mentioned in ''[[XY032|The Aura Storm!]]''. After [[Korrina's Lucario]] went berserk in its [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] form for the second time, {{an|Korrina}}'s grandfather [[Gurkinn]] ordered her to restart her training with Lucario. He sent her to Pomace Mountain, where a Trainer lived that had helped train Gurkinn in his younger days. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to assist Korrina in her journey. Pomace Mountain appeared in ''[[XY034|The Bonds of Mega Evolution!]]'', where the group arrived there and met [[Mabel]], the Trainer Gurkinn mentioned. Mabel had Korrina and the group arrange flowers with their Pokémon to strengthen their bonds.
